dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Duel

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: How could this be...

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: Hmph, that's what I think about when nobody's buying books. I won't let you win that easily.

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: So... are you gonna buy a book or not?

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: At your skill level, you should play more!

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: Guess everyone's interested in history now, eh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: A lot of people have become interested in Liyue's history recently, and many of them have been coming to my store to buy books...

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: In the past, it would take half a year to sell the few copies of "Yakshas: The Guardian Adepti" that we had, so I stopped importing such obscure history books...

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: But after the recent events that happened here, people from all over the city would come here to purchase history texts...

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: These past few days have been full of customers who specifically wanted books containing Rex Lapis' stories.

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: *sigh* Who knows if they really love reading, or if they're just looking to inject a bit of spice into their daily chatter...

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: Due to the surge in demand, I've almost had no time to attend to some special orders that we've gotten from old customers.

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: I finally found the time to put together the books that two such customers wanted, but I'm too busy to leave the store at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: Could you help me send this copy of "Verses of Equilibrium" to Uncle Tian, and this copy of "Rex Incognito (IV)" to Gentry De'an?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll do it.

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: Thank you very much. They must surely be growing impatient by now. After all, they placed their orders a long time ago, but I've only just gotten around to putting those orders together...

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: *sigh* With so many customers all of a sudden, I barely know how to keep up...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd love to, but I have to get going.

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: No problem. I'll look for someone else to help me out.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "Records of Jueyun"?

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: You seem like you could handle it. See what you think of this one: Records of Jueyun - Stone Beasts.

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: Take it with you if you want. Just bring it back when you get sick of it.

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: ...I won't hold my breath, though, I've had plenty of customers who borrow books and don't return them.

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: Found one you like? Please pay over here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I want to know about the Wanwen Bookhouse.

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: Strange, most people who come here are looking for books, not the bookhouse itself...

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: Anyway, my husband is the one with a bit of a thing for collecting old books. But he doesn't earn any money...

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: That's why I opened this place. Got to make a living somehow.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: Typical. You sit there reading the book in-store, then as soon as I ask if you want to buy it you're all, "Oh, I'm just browsing" and "Oh, I might come back tomorrow..."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm looking to buy some books.

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: Pick them out yourself. When you find one you like, pay here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Any recommended reads?

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: Let's see... If you like poetry, Humor From Tianheng is selling well at the moment. Seems to have a mass appeal.

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: If you're a visitor in town, you might enjoy Records of Jueyun. It's not for the faint-hearted, though.

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: I'm just taking a look around the market. Don't forget to stop by the Wanwen Bookhouse if you have time.

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: Although, the store is full of old books that won't sell... I'm half inclined to turn them into scrap paper and donate them as Mingxiao Lantern supplies.
